style: stylized dark-fantasy ARPG, 3/4 top-down friendly, slightly cartoon

referencePolicy.note: Reference image is never uploaded. Design is described in original words; differences are listed below.
differences: helmet: reference has tall winged crown; ours is a rounded dome with a low horizontal fin crest and no wings
neck/shoulders: reference has a white fur collar; ours has a plain metal gorget and large round sun-disk pauldrons
lower body: reference has a long robe/tabard; ours is a short navy tabard above the knees over a silver chain skirt
palette: reference is white-silver with gold; ours is gold-dominant with silver trim and navy cloth
emblem: sun-disk radial motif (original) instead of the reference's ornaments
proportions: stylized ~5.5 heads with chunky gauntlets and greaves, not realistic
weapon: one-handed leaf-blade broadsword with sun-disk pommel, not the reference's two-handed sword

preview.prompt: Full-body stylized dark-fantasy knight, cartoon proportions about 5.5 heads tall, standing in A-pose, arms slightly away from the body, legs apart, facing forward. Heavy plate armor in polished gold with silver trim and dark engraved lines. Rounded dome helmet with a horizontal slit visor and a low fin crest, no wings. Large round shoulder pauldrons with a radiating sun-disk emblem, segmented gold chest plate, chunky gauntlets and greaves. Short dark navy tabard ending above the knees over a silver chain skirt. Right hand holds a one-handed broadsword with a leaf-shaped blade and sun-disk pommel, blade length about half the character height, pointing down. Hand-painted game art style, clean readable silhouette, plain background.

refine.texture_prompt: Hand-painted stylized gold armor with silver trim, dark navy cloth, subtle scratches, warm highlights, no baked lighting
